label: Original Field kit — physical nylon
decision: Use this exact original artwork as the background for the main character sheet. Later nylon variants are not selected for this target.
implementation: Derive the delivered WEBP from the approved PNG master. Preserve artwork identity and aspect ratio; no regeneration, redrawing or substitution. Consumer crop, rendering and compression are integration work.
scope: Main character sheet only. Other sheet families remain separate decisions. Workshop remains kept from the previous review.
